cards.title: Say list
sections: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides. Join the sounds into one word without adding extra vowels.
Listen. Say it. Record a second attempt after checking one sound.
cards.name: Everyday English - A1 - Day 091 - Pronunciation & Listening - 01

articulation.label: list
articulation.alt: list: /l/ → /ɪ/ → /s/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
